title: Brouwer characterization of Cantor space
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: A topological space is homeomorphic to Cantor space, the countable product of discrete Boolean spaces, if and only if it is nonempty, compact, metrizable, has a basis of clopen sets, and has no isolated points. A full binary clopen scheme decides an enumerated basis one element at each depth. Its point-address map is continuous; compact nested intersections realize every binary branch, and basis decisions separate points. A continuous bijection from a compact space to the Hausdorff Cantor space is a homeomorphism. This formalizes a classical theorem of Brouwer; no mathematical novelty or…

review.reason: Formal proof of Brouwer's characterization of Cantor space via clopen bases.
